caption: The drawing features a single pink shoe, viewed from the left side, prominently displayed in the center of a tan textured background. The shoe has a low, angled heel and a pointed toe, decorated on the top with a small floral or botanical embroidery. The shoe includes a wrapover upper detail accentuated by fine darker pink outlining, adding dimensionality to the structure. Above the shoe, oriented toward the left upper corner, there are two smaller, lightly drawn outlines of the shoe in pencil: one is a top-down view with interior detailing, and the other is an empty outline from the top. The artist's signature "Nancy S. Ruan" is neatly inscribed near the bottom left of the image. The composition uses subdued, soft colors and minimal elements, focusing attention on the shoe’s design and construction.
title: Woman's Slipper
